novex_description: Founded in 1987, Novex is a renowned UK brand that pioneered the wiring accessories industry and, after achieving great success, expanded its product offerings to meet a wider range of consumer needs. Now, as a leading brand under Buraq Star. Novex Known for its durable power tools, hand tools, fans, ceramic fittings, and water heaters. The brand also specializes in electrical solutions, offering energy-efficient lighting and light fittings, as well as premium kitchen and bath faucets, shower systems and advanced PPR piping solutions.
zilco_description: ZILCO, established in 1995, has become a leading name in the switchgear industry, renowned for its commitment to safety, reliability, and modern design. Over the years, ZILCO has specialized in providing high-quality electrical solutions, offering a comprehensive range of products that cater to residential, commercial, and industrial needs. ZILCO’s product portfolio includes: ELCBs (Earth Leakage Circuit Breakers), MCBs (Miniature Circuit Breakers), MCCB (Moulded Case Circuit Breakers), RCBOs (Residual Current Breakers with Overload Protection), Isolators, Metal Enclosures and Accessories, Thermal Relays, AC Contactors, Motor Starters & Distribution Boxes.
cavil_description: Cavil established in 2016 and a renowned Italian brand famous for its pioneering innovations in both residential and commercial applications. Cavil’s extensive range includes, Wall-Mounted Extractor Fans, Ceiling Fan Exhaust Ventilators’ Advanced Air Circulation Systems, Energy-Efficient LED Lighting Appliances, Premium Bath and Sanitary Fittings.
buraq_description: Buraq is a Pakistan-origin brand established in 2006, specializing in ventilation systems and water pumps designed for comfort, efficiency, and reliability. With a commitment to innovation and quality, Buraq provides solutions that simplify everyday living and deliver optimal performance for both residential and commercial needs.
who_we_are_description: Buraq Star Trading Co. LLC has been a trusted name in the UAE since 2002, specializing in designing, producing, and distributing premium brands—including NOVEX, ZILCO, BURAQ, and CAVIL—with a strong commitment to excellence and innovation. We deliver high-quality products through a robust international distribution network. Our dedication to staying ahead of market trends is reflected in our growing e-commerce platform, offering customers convenient access to our diverse range of products anytime, anywhere.
our_operations_description_1: Buraq Star Trading Co. L.L.C. operates from Dubai & Sharjah, UAE, where we manage expansive, state-of-the-art showrooms for customers to see and test each product. We have warehouses with significant storage capacity to efficiently handle our wide range of products.
our_operations_description_2: In addition to our extensive warehousing capabilities, we boast a robust delivery network that ensures our products reach customers across the UAE and beyond with reliability. Our retail outlets and showrooms further exemplify our commitment to providing direct access to our premium brands, including Buraq, Novex, Zilco, and Cavil.
our_operations_description_3: With a strong presence in the UAE, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain, and Pakistan reinforcing our regional footprint, we continue to serve a growing customer base with excellence and innovation.
vision_description: To be a global leader in innovative, high-quality products that enrich lives and set new standards of excellence.
mission_description: To create world-class products under our brands—Buraq, Novex, Zilco, and Cavil—that seamlessly combine functionality and aesthetics, delivering exceptional value to customers.
order_cancellation_return_policy_intro: At Buraq Star, we strive to ensure a seamless shopping experience. Below is our Order Cancellation & Return Policy in accordance with standard customer online rights.
order_cancellation_before_dispatch_descr:
- Customers may cancel their order any time before it is dispatched.
- To cancel your order, please contact our customer service team immediately through email or phone, providing your order number.
cancellation_after_dispatch_description:
- Once an order has been dispatched, it cannot be canceled.
- However, you may initiate a return or refund as per our return policy.
non_cancellable_orders_description:
- Certain items may be non-cancellable due to their nature.
- These will be clearly specified on the product page at the time of purchase.
refunds_for_canceled_orders_description:
- If you cancel your order before dispatch, a credit note or voucher of equivalent value will be issued.
- This credit note or voucher can be used for future purchases on our platform.
- The credit note or voucher will be processed and sent within 14 business days.
how_to_cancel_an_order_description:
- Contact our customer service team at **info@buraqstar.com** or **800 66839**.
- Provide your order number and reason for cancellation (if applicable).
- Ensure the goods are returned in their original condition (if already received).
exceptions_to_cancellation_description: - We reserve the right to refuse cancellation or returns if the item is not returned in its original condition, is damaged, or has missing parts.
return_window_description:
- Customers have **7 days** from the date of delivery to return an item.
- Returns initiated beyond the **7-day window** will not be accepted.
condition_of_returned_items_description:
- The item must be in its **original, unused condition**, with all tags, packaging, and accessories intact.
- Items that are **damaged, altered, used, or missing parts** will not be eligible for return.
non_returnable_items_description:
- Certain items, such as **personalized or hygiene-related products**, may not be eligible for return.
- These exclusions will be clearly mentioned on the product page.
refund_policy_description:
- Once the returned item is **received and inspected**, we will issue a **credit note or voucher** of the same value as the returned product.
- The credit note or voucher can be used for future purchases on our platform.
- **No cash refunds** will be provided.
return_process_description:
- Contact our customer service team within **7 days** of receiving your order to initiate a return.
- Provide your order number and reason for return.
- Return instructions, including the address for shipping the item back, will be provided upon approval of your request.
return_shipping_costs_description:
- The customer is responsible for the **shipping costs** associated with returning the item.
- If the return is due to an **error on our part** (e.g., incorrect or defective item), the shipping cost will be covered by us.
inspection_and_approval_description:
- All returns will be inspected upon arrival to ensure they meet the conditions outlined above.
- If the return is **approved**, the **credit note or voucher** will be processed within **15 business days**.
changes_to_the_policy_description: - This policy is subject to change. Any updates will be posted on our website.
shipping_policy_intro: At Buraq Star, we are committed to providing a seamless and reliable shopping experience. Please read our shipping policy carefully.
shipping_locations_description:
Currently, Buraq Star offers shipping only within the following countries:

- United Arab Emirates (UAE)
- Pakistan
- Bahrain
- Qatar

We do not offer international shipping outside of these countries. Orders placed from other locations will not be processed.
delivery_process_description:
Once your order is successfully placed, we process it for local delivery within your country. Our delivery partners ensure secure and timely shipping.

- **UAE:** Orders are delivered via local UAE delivery services.
- **Pakistan:** Orders are handled by trusted domestic shipping partners.
- **Bahrain:** Reliable local delivery services manage Bahrain shipments.
- **Qatar:** Authorized local couriers fulfill all orders within Qatar.
shipping_timeframes_description:
- Delivery times vary based on your location.
- Estimated delivery time is **7 to 15 business days** depending on the delivery address and stock availability.
- Delivery times are confirmed during checkout.
shipping_charges_description: Shipping charges are calculated at checkout based on your delivery location and order size/weight. We offer competitive shipping rates for maximum value.
order_tracking_description: Once your order is shipped, you will receive an email with tracking information. You can use the tracking number to monitor your order status.
delivery_issues_description: If you experience any delivery issues (e.g., delays, damage, or missing items), please contact our customer service team immediately. We will investigate and assist in resolving the issue promptly.
return_and_refund_policy_description: If you are unsatisfied with your purchase or encounter a problem, please refer to our [Return and Refund Policy] for details.

faq_question_1: What types of products does Buraq Star offer?
faq_answer_1: Buraq Star offers a wide range of high-quality products under the brands Novex, Zilco, Cavil, and Buraq. We offer electrical supplies, sanitary ware, hand and power tools, hardware, and paint accessories. We provide top-quality products for all your project needs.
faq_question_2: Are the products available for international shipping?
faq_answer_2: No, we don’t offer international shipping on our products. Please check our shipping policy for more details on delivery times and costs.
faq_question_3: How do I know if a product is right for me?
faq_answer_3: Each product on our website comes with a detailed description, specifications, and usage instructions to help you make an informed decision. If you have any specific questions, feel free to contact us.
faq_question_4: Are Buraq Star products covered by a warranty?
faq_answer_4: Yes, all our products come with a manufacturer’s warranty. Warranty details are listed on the product page, and you can also contact us for more information.
faq_question_5: What payment methods do you accept?
faq_answer_5: We accept a variety of payment methods, including credit/debit cards, PayPal, and other secure payment gateways.
faq_question_6: How do I track my order?
faq_answer_6: Once your order is shipped, we will send you an email with a tracking number. You can use this number to track your order on our website or through the shipping provider.
faq_question_7: Can I return or exchange a product?
faq_answer_7: Yes, we offer a return and exchange policy. If you are not satisfied with your product, please review our return policy on the website for instructions.
faq_question_8: How can I contact customer support?
faq_answer_8: You can reach our customer support team via email, phone, or by filling out the contact form on our website. We aim to respond within 24 hours.
faq_question_9: Are the products safe to use outdoors?
faq_answer_9: Yes, most of our products, including the solar lights and tools, are designed for outdoor use and are weather-resistant. Please check the individual product specifications for more details on durability and safety.
faq_question_10: Do you offer installation services for your products?
faq_answer_10: At the moment, we do not offer installation services, but our products come with clear instructions for easy setup. If you need assistance, our customer support is happy to guide you.
faq_question_11: Can I cancel my order after placing it?
faq_answer_11: If you need to cancel your order, please contact us as soon as possible. Once an order has been processed or shipped, we may not be able to cancel it. Please refer to our cancellation policy for more details.
faq_question_12: What should I do if my product is damaged or faulty?
faq_answer_12: If you receive a damaged or faulty product, please contact our customer support team within 7 days of delivery. We will assist with returns, exchanges, or replacements as per our policy.
faq_answer_13: Currently, we do not offer customization for our products. However, we continually update our inventory, so check back for new product releases.

seo_instagram.title: Your One-Stop Shop for Quality Building, Electrical, and Sanitary Supplies!
seo_instagram.paragraph1: In the ever-evolving world of construction and maintenance, having access to top-notch materials is essential. At Buraq Star Trading, we understand the significance of reliable supplies for your projects, whether you're constructing a commercial building, renovating a residential space, or simply upgrading your home. That's why we've made it our mission to provide you with everything you need under one roof.
seo_instagram.paragraph2: Quality is our cornerstone. We believe that the success of any project hinges on the materials used, and that's why we source only the best. From robust building materials to cutting-edge electrical components and premium sanitary supplies, we have it all. Our extensive selection ensures that you can find everything required to complete your project to the highest standards.
seo_instagram.paragraph3: When it comes to building supplies, we've got you covered. Whether you're laying foundations, erecting walls, or adding the finishing touches, you can trust in the quality and durability of our products. We work closely with reputable suppliers to bring you materials that meet industry standards and exceed your expectations.
seo_instagram.paragraph4: Electrical work requires precision and reliability, and that's exactly what you'll find in our electrical supplies. From wiring and cables to switches and outlets, we offer a comprehensive selection of electrical components to suit your needs. Safety is paramount, which is why we stock products that are rigorously tested and certified. With our electrical supplies, you can ensure that your projects are not only functional but also secure.
seo_instagram.paragraph5: In the realm of sanitation, hygiene and quality go hand in hand. Our sanitary supplies are designed to meet the highest standards of cleanliness and durability. From faucets and sinks to toilets and showers, we provide a wide array of options to suit every budget and style. We understand the importance of efficiency in sanitation, which is why our products are not only easy to install but also simple to maintain.
seo_instagram.paragraph6: At Buraq Star Trading, convenience is key. We know that time is of the essence in any project, which is why we strive to make your shopping experience as seamless as possible. Our user-friendly website allows you to browse our extensive catalog from the comfort of your home or office. With just a few clicks, you can find the products you need and have them delivered right to your doorstep.
seo_instagram.paragraph7: But our commitment to excellence doesn't stop there. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional customer service every step of the way. Our knowledgeable staff are here to assist you with any questions or concerns you may have, ensuring that you have the information you need to make informed decisions.
seo_instagram.paragraph8: Whether you're a seasoned contractor, a DIY enthusiast, or a homeowner embarking on a renovation project, Buraq Star Trading is your ultimate destination for quality building, electrical, and sanitary supplies. With our extensive selection, superior quality, and outstanding service, we're here to help you bring your projects to life. Shop with us today and experience the difference for yourself!
